description: Kioku — MCP server for Obsidian vault access. Enables AI agents to search, read and write notes via the Model Context Protocol.
name: io.github.sandovaldavid/kioku

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_VAULT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the Obsidian vault root directory

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_OBSIDIAN_PORT
environmentVariables.description: WebSocket port for the Obsidian plugin bridge (default: 7765)

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_BRIDGE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Shared secret for the Obsidian bridge WebSocket; must match the plugin's Auth token setting

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_OLLAMA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Ollama server URL for semantic embeddings (default: http://localhost:11434)

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_GEN_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Ollama model for local text generation used by summarize_note (default: disabled), e.g. llama3.2

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: MCP transport: stdio or http (default: stdio)

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Streamable HTTP transport port when KIOKU_TRANSPORT=http (default: 5173)

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token required by the HTTP transport when set; required for non-loopback binds unless the unsafe override is enabled

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_HTTP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated exact browser origins allowed to call the HTTP transport

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_HTTP_TRUSTED_PROXIES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated proxy IP addresses trusted to supply forwarded headers

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_HTTP_MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum MCP HTTP request body size in bytes (default: 1048576)

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_HTTP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum MCP POST request duration in seconds (default: 300)

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_ALLOW_INSECURE_HTTP
environmentVariables.description: Unsafe override permitting a non-loopback HTTP bind without KIOKU_API_KEY (default: false)

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: GitHub token used by the share_as_gist tool
